statements.t: “We delivered an exceptional third quarter as we successfully executed our enhanced distribution strategy, began the ramp-up of our Arkansas manufacturing facility, generated record third quarter revenue, and again increased our full-year outlook,” said Adam Zambanini, President and CEO.

We further warrant that Trex Transcend, Trex Enhance and Trex Select decking and cladding and Universal Fascia products will not fade in color from light and weathering exposure more than a certain amount and will be resistant to permanent staining from food and beverage substances or mold and mildew, provided the stain is cleaned within seven days of appearance, for the warranty period referred to above.
